inputThis: $:set -e; CODESPACE_NAME=$(gh codespace list --repo BestNameYet/Terminals --json name,repository --jq '.[]|select(.repository=="BestNameYet/Terminals")|.name' | head -n 1); test -n "$CODESPACE_NAME"; echo "CODESPACE_NAME=$CODESPACE_NAME"; gh api --method POST "user/codespaces/${CODESPACE_NAME}/start" >/dev/null || true; gh codespace ssh -c "$CODESPACE_NAME" -- "bash -lc 'cd /workspaces/Terminals && printf \"HEAD=\" && git rev-parse HEAD && printf \"NODE=\" && node --version && printf \"STRACE=\" && (command -v strace || true) && printf \"MODULE_COUNT=\" && find workspaces/codespace-terminal-mcp/node_modules -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l && printf \"LOCKFILE=\" && test -f workspaces/codespace-terminal-mcp/package-lock.json && echo YES || echo NO && printf \"PROCESS=\" && pgrep -af \"node http-server.mjs\" || true'"
